_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior entry door prime+paint. Context prefix XDOR (eXterior DOoR) — no collision with existing prefixes. Interior door slab uses DOOR_ prefix. Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). Single paintable item (door assembly EA) with 3 substrate materials and 3 complexity tiers as configuration dimensions. QT3-QT5 (QT2 excluded — entry doors are architectural focal points).

paintable_items.name: Exterior entry door assembly
paintable_items.notes: Single EA item covering the complete door assembly: both faces, all 4 edges, frame/jamb, glass lite painting (mullions), sidelite/transom painting (grand_entry). Does NOT include casing (SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 scope). Complexity dimension (single_slab/panel/grand_entry) drives time per EA. Substrate material (steel/fiberglass/wood) drives primer system and prep protocol.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR (interior slab), CEIL, WALL, TRIM (interior), WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM. XDOR is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_XDOR_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_XDOR_REMOVE_HARDWARE, TSK_XDOR_DEGLOSS_STEEL, TSK_XDOR_PRIME_SPRAY, TSK_XDOR_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_XDOR_SAND_INTERCOAT, TSK_XDOR_MASK_GLASS, TSK_XDOR_SEAL_BOTTOM_EDGE

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — hardware removal, weatherstrip removal/tape, threshold protection, glass masking, entry walkway protection
Surface prep — substrate-driven: solvent clean + degloss (steel), soap wash (fiberglass), sand + fill + spot-prime knots (wood). Varies by substrate_material and substrate_state.
Primer application — conditional on substrate_state. DTM primer (bare metal), acrylic latex (bare wood, fiberglass), skip for factory-primed steel/fiberglass. Wood six-side seal included.
First finish coat — spray face + brush panel recesses and edges. Application method per door substrate and complexity.
Intercoat inspection + sand. QT3: visual inspect only. QT4: light sand 220-grit. QT5: hand-sand with raking light inspection.
Second finish coat — same method as first coat.
Hardware reinstall, weatherstrip re-insert, glass masking removal. QT5: final coat may be applied with door hanging for gravity leveling.
Final inspection, touch-up, protection teardown, tool cleaning.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of exterior doors to paint. Each door assembly is 1 EA regardless of size. Grand entry with sidelites/transom is still 1 EA.
paintscope_keys.notes: Primary quantity driver. Complexity and substrate dimensions determine rate per EA.

paintscope_keys.description: Door complexity classification — single_slab, panel, or grand_entry. Per-door capture because a project may have mixed complexity (front=grand_entry, side=single_slab).
paintscope_keys.notes: PRIMARY cost driver. Routes to correct production rate tier. Values: single_slab, panel, grand_entry.

paintscope_keys.description: Door substrate material — steel, fiberglass, or wood. Per-door capture for mixed-substrate projects.
paintscope_keys.notes: Drives primer system selection, topcoat chemistry restrictions, and prep protocol. Values: steel, fiberglass, wood.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag confirming new construction context.
paintscope_keys.notes: Already registered by sibling exterior specs (FC siding, trim).

paintscope_keys.description: Count of exterior doors with glass lites requiring masking. Includes sidelite/transom glass on grand entry assemblies.
paintscope_keys.notes: Already proposed/registered by SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1. This spec consumes same key — door spec masks glass when painting the door itself.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of hardware groups to remove/reinstall per door. Standard door = 1 group (lockset + deadbolt + strike plates + hinges). Grand entry may have additional hardware (knocker, mail slot, doorbell).
paintscope_keys.notes: Typically 1:1 with door count but grand entry may have 2+ hardware groups.

paintscope_keys.description: Adjacent entry walkway/porch/stoop area requiring drop cloth protection.
Number of building elevations — used for per-elevation access type determination.
Access type per elevation. Doors are typically ground level. Ladder modifier only for elevated entries (deck/raised porch).

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — exterior entry doors are high-visibility architectural focal points. QT5 is applicable because grand entries and showcase homes justify supreme finish (door removed, painted in controlled environment, hand-sand between all coats, DFT verification).

application_method.notes: Spray is PRIMARY for door faces (factory-smooth finish quality). Roller is NOT valid — introduces orange peel on door faces. Brush is for: panel recesses, all 4 edges, detail work, and small projects where spray setup is not justified. Back-rolling AVOIDED on metal doors.

sheen.notes: No locked-in default — project-level selection. Semi-gloss is most common for exterior doors. Steel doors: caution with gloss per ANSI A250.8 (emphasizes welding marks). Gloss requires higher prep quality.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA is primary UOM for the door assembly. FIXED for per-project fixed tasks (tool cleaning). No SF or LF direct — everything is bundled into the per-EA rate. Rates are hours/EA, not SF/hr.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_METAL is a proposed new state (see registry_additions_proposed). SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is dominant NC state for steel/fiberglass. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD is dominant for wood doors. Factory-primed steel/fiberglass may skip field prime (unlike fiber cement siding where field prime is mandatory).

product_role.notes: Specialty for IR-reflective cool paint technology (dark colors LRV < 30). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Full_mask for glass lites. Item_mask for individual hardware pieces. Light_mask for threshold, walkway. Hardware is removed (not masked).

surface_ids.notes: door_slab_ext and door_frame_ext are proposed new surface IDs. ext_trim_door_casing and siding_field exist in registry. door_frame_ext is the exterior door frame/jamb — distinct from interior door_frame. Door slab exterior face and interior face are both in scope (standard NC practice paints both faces).

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM — interior DTM primer for steel windows, similar concept but interior
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — exterior acrylic primer for wood siding, same chemistry but siding-specific
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN — exterior tannin-blocking primer, same concept for door tannin species
SYS_EXT_TRIM_PRIMER_BONDING — bonding primer for PVC trim, similar adhesion concept
SYS_EXT_TRIM_FINISH_STANDARD — standard exterior trim paint, similar tier
SYS_EXT_TRIM_FINISH_PREMIUM — premium exterior trim paint, similar tier

proposed_systems.name: DTM Primer for Steel Exterior Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Zinc-rich epoxy or alkyd for bare carbon steel. Vinyl wash or acrylic etching for galvanized. Universal DTM for factory-primed steel needing re-prime.

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Primer for Fiberglass/Wood Doors
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic latex exterior primer. MANDATORY for fiberglass (oil-based prohibited due to outgassing). For wood: general primer for non-tannin species. Alkyd spot-prime knots separately on tannin-rich species.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Spot-applied to visible knots on tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood). Not a full-surface system. Applied before full acrylic primer coat.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Door Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior enamel. Satin/semi-gloss/gloss per project selection. Fiberglass doors: 100% acrylic ONLY — no alkyd or oil-modified.

proposed_systems.name: Premium Exterior Door Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Premium acrylic enamel (SW Emerald, BM Aura). Enhanced durability, UV resistance, color retention. QT5 may specify architect-matched formulation.

proposed_systems.name: IR-Reflective Exterior Door Paint for Dark Colors
proposed_systems.notes: MANDATORY for dark colors (LRV < 30). Complex Inorganic Color Pigments (CICPs) drop surface temperature 20-30 deg F. Without IR-reflective technology: wood joint failure, steel thermal expansion, fiberglass outgassing acceleration. HARD STOP for steel doors below LRV 30.

material_system_prefix.notes: 3 substrate-driven primers (DTM for steel, acrylic for fiberglass/wood, tannin spot for wood knots) + 2 QT-driven finish systems + 1 conditional IR-reflective system for dark colors. Door finish is standard exterior grade (not fine-finish) but higher quality than siding due to architectural visibility.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 310 (metal/fiberglass doors)
proposed_consumables.notes: 310 or 412 tip for metal/fiberglass door faces. 0.010-0.014 inch orifice per Application Methods Doctrine.

proposed_consumables.name: Glass Masking Film (HDPE static-cling or liquid mask)
proposed_consumables.notes: HDPE static-cling film for glass lites. QT5: liquid mask for razor-sharp paint lines. Per door, not per lite.

proposed_consumables.name: Two-Component Auto Body Filler (steel door dent repair)
proposed_consumables.notes: For dent repair on steel doors. Sand 80-grit, fill, finish-sand 240/300-grit. Only for steel substrate with dent damage.

proposed_consumables.name: Xylene or Acetone for Steel Door Solvent Clean
proposed_consumables.notes: Solvent cleaning for steel door surfaces. Remove manufacturing oils, contaminants.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 prime + 2 finish coats — standard NC sequence for bare substrates
2 finish coats only — factory-primed steel/fiberglass (adequate factory primer) or field-primed

round_configurations.notes: Existing ROUND_DOOR_ configurations are for interior door slab. Exterior door rounds need separate XDOR prefix because substrate state routing differs (factory-primed steel/fiberglass can skip field prime unlike NC wood).

proposed_profiles.description: DTM primer coverage on steel door — 350-400 SF/gal. EA conversion: ~1 door = ~40 SF (both faces + edges) = ~0.10-0.12 gal per door.
Acrylic primer coverage on wood/fiberglass door — 300-400 SF/gal. ~0.10-0.13 gal per door.
Finish coat coverage on primed door — 300-400 SF/gal. ~0.10-0.13 gal per door per coat.

deduplication_notes: Door CASING painting belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 — this spec covers door slab, edges, frame/jamb, and glass lite masking only.
Glass masking ownership: when painting the DOOR, this spec masks the glass. When painting the CASING, the trim spec masks adjacent glass (ext_door_glass_adjacent zone).
Door-to-frame weatherseal gap is PROTECTED (not caulked) by this spec. Casing-to-wall caulking is trim spec scope.
Siding-to-door junction: no direct adjacency — casing intervenes. No deduplication needed.

proposed_modifiers.description: Door complexity modifier — PRIMARY cost driver
proposed_modifiers.notes: Applied to base EA rate. Single_slab is baseline (1.0-2.0 hrs/EA). Panel: 1.5-3.0 hrs/EA. Grand_entry: 5.0-10.0 hrs/EA. Grand_entry modifier is very high because it adds sidelite/transom scope. Values are approximate — Estimation Engineer calibrates exact rates.
Rarely applicable — most exterior doors are at grade. Ladder modifier for elevated deck/porch entries. Scaffold/lift not typically needed for door painting.

production_json.ea_rate_note: This spec uses hours/EA rates (not SF/hr or LF/hr). Production rates should use rate_per_hour where the rate is doors/hour (inverse of hours/door) or fixed_time_minutes for per-door tasks.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_XDOR_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_DOOR_EXT MUST be used exactly as registered (proposed ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Entry Door Prime and Paint (New Construction)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior entry doors — distinct from interior door slab spec (SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC). Different domain (exterior), different substrate materials (steel/fiberglass/wood), different primer systems (DTM, acrylic, tannin), IR-reflective coating requirement for dark colors, hardware removal mandate, and six-side sealing for wood.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior entry door assembly
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM_ covers exterior door. Interior door items (ITM_DOOR_FRAME_SET) cover frame, not slab. The interior door slab is implicit in SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC but uses EA_SIDE UOM. Exterior door uses EA per assembly (both faces + edges + frame/jamb). Different counting model.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door slab surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for exterior door slab. Existing door_leaf_face is interior-specific. Exterior door has different substrate materials, weathering considerations, and coating requirements.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door frame/jamb surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for exterior door frame. Existing door_frame is interior-specific. Exterior frame has weatherstrip interface, threshold junction, and different coating requirements.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door glass lite masking
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for glass lites in door slab and sidelites/transom. Distinct from ext_door_glass_adjacent (trim spec — glass adjacent to casing). This zone is glass IN the door assembly.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door hardware removal/reinstall zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for exterior door hardware. Not a masking zone — hardware is REMOVED per doctrine. Distinct from interior hardware_covers which may be masked.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door weatherstrip protection zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for weatherstripping. Pull out friction-fit stripping or deep-tape non-removable stripping. No existing zone covers weatherstrip protection.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door threshold/sill protection zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for threshold protection during door painting. Tape and drop cloth to catch drips.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Door Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PaintScope key for exterior door count. No existing PS_OPENING_EA covers exterior doors. Interior door keys use different patterns (PS_SURFACE_EA.DOOR_FRAME_SET, PS_SURFACE_EA_SIDE.DOOR_SLAB).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Complexity Enum (single_slab/panel/grand_entry)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum for complexity classification. PRIMARY cost driver — routes to correct production rate tier. Must be captured per door (project may have mixed complexity).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Substrate Material Enum (steel/fiberglass/wood)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum for substrate material. Drives primer system, topcoat chemistry, and prep protocol. Must be per-door (project may have mixed substrates).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Hardware Group Count for Removal/Reinstall
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection key for hardware removal/reinstall count. Typically 1:1 with door count. Grand entry may have additional hardware groups.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Door Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.DOOR_EXT.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Complexity Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.DOOR_COMPLEXITY.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Substrate Material Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_TYPE_DOOR.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door Hardware Group Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior bare metal (ferrous or non-ferrous, no primer/coating)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New exterior substrate state for bare metal doors. Distinct from existing SS_BARE (interior generic bare). Triggers DTM/zinc-rich primer path. Rare in NC (most steel doors arrive factory-primed) but must be handled.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior painted finish — gloss sheen
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New output state for gloss-sheen exterior painting. SS_EXT_PAINTED_SATIN and SS_EXT_PAINTED_SEMIGLOSS already exist/proposed. Gloss is a valid exterior door sheen not yet represented. Also proposed by SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Primer for Steel Exterior Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Distinct from interior SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM (steel windows) — exterior door DTM primer has different environmental exposure requirements and may use zinc-rich epoxy for carbon steel.

registry_additions_proposed.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Primer for Fiberglass/Wood Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Exterior door-specific acrylic primer. Fiberglass REQUIRES 100% acrylic (oil prohibited). Distinct from siding primer (SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC) — different coverage rates and application method (brush vs spray).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Spot primer for tannin-rich wood species (cedar, redwood). Not a full-surface system. Similar to SYS_EXT_TRIM_PRIMER_ALKYD_SPOT but door-specific context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Door Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT3 door finish. Distinct from siding and trim finish systems — different coverage rates on EA door vs SF/LF siding/trim.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium Exterior Door Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT4/QT5 door finish with premium materials. High-visibility entry point justifies premium product.

registry_additions_proposed.name: IR-Reflective Exterior Door Paint for Dark Colors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: MANDATORY for LRV < 30. Complex Inorganic Color Pigments (CICPs). No existing SYS_ covers IR-reflective exterior door coating. HARD STOP requirement — without IR-reflective technology, dark colors cause substrate failure (wood warping, steel expansion, fiberglass outgassing).

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Primer Coverage on Steel Door
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Door-specific DTM primer coverage. EA-based conversion needed (~40 SF per door = ~0.10-0.12 gal/door).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Primer Coverage on Wood/Fiberglass Door
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Door-specific acrylic primer coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Finish Coat Coverage on Primed Door
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Door-specific finish coverage.
